Field Name: Wakeup Event Enable On SD Card Removal
Description: This bit enables wakeup event via Card Removal assertion in the Normal Interrupt Status register. This bit can be set to 1 if FN_WUS (Wake Up Support) in CIS is set to support this bit.

Field Name: Wakeup Event Enable On SD Card Insertion
Description: This bit enables wakeup event via Card Insertion assertion in the Normal Interrupt Status register. This bit can be set to 1 if FN_WUS (Wake Up Support) in CIS does not affect this bit.

Field Name: Wakeup Event Enable On Card Interrupt
Description: This bit enables wakeup event via Card Interrupt assertion in the Normal Interrupt Status register. This bit can be set to 1 if FN_WUS (Wake Up Support) in CIS is set to support this bit.
